title: Residential Natural Gas Supply — Settlement of an Earned Sign-Up Credit Not Yet Posted
content:
## Scope

On a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement, this policy settles a sign-up credit that an agreement still on the plan it was enrolled on earned once its completed billing cycles reached the plan's sign-up qualification count, while the plan's sign-up credit amount is above 0.00, and that was never posted.

A completed billing cycle is a cycle of the agreement's energy charge lines whose billing period has ended.

## Posting

The sign-up credit owed is posted once, as a negative sign-up credit, on the bill of the billing cycle that starts the day after the latest billed cycle ends.

The sign-up credit is posted only while the agreement is active or drop pending, and never more than once per agreement.

| Agreement condition | Settlement |
|---|---|
| active or drop pending, credit earned, no sign-up credit line on the ledger | posted once |
| a sign-up credit line already stands | not posted again |
| status other than active or drop pending | not posted |

*Illustration (hypothetical dates).* When the latest billed cycle ends 9 March, the credit is posted on the bill of the cycle that starts 10 March.

## Recording the credit

**Capability.** `post_gas_signup_credit_32aac0cb` posts the one-time sign-up bill credit on a residential gas agreement. One call adds one new sign-up credit line to the agreement's bill ledger, dated today and shown on the bill of the billing cycle given; the credit is stored as a negative amount equal to the value given. Afterwards the credit appears in the agreement's bill lines as a sign-up credit.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_gas_signup_credit_32aac0cb` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `gas_agreement_id` — the residential natural gas agreement number credited, as returned by the gas agreement lookup.
- `billing_period_start` — the first day of the billing cycle on whose bill the credit appears, written YYYY-MM-DD.
- `credit_amount_usd` — the credit amount in US dollars, given as a positive amount with 2 decimal places (rounded half to even at the third place if more places are given); it is posted as the matching negative amount.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence giving the new credit line's reference number, the agreement number, the billing cycle start (YYYY-MM-DD), the amount credited in US dollars to 2 decimal places and the posting date (today, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving it means the sign-up credit is on the ledger.
